verse: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in. Isaiah 58:12.
title: Hands That Heal, Hearts That Hope
bullets: God calls us to repair what sin has broken by combining faithful proclamation of His truth with genuine compassion for suffering people.
Medical missionary work and practical service open doors to hearts that are closed to words alone, making way for the gospel's deepest healing.
When we live the gospel through both physical care and spiritual ministry, we reveal Christ's tender love and demonstrate salvation's true power.
prayer: Lord, help me see the suffering around me with Your eyes of compassion, and give me courage to serve both body and soul as Your hands in this broken world. May my works of mercy always point others to Your redeeming love.
